NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    guideline "Maintain weight or slow gain per OB guidance; target +250..350 kcal/day above pre-pregnancy maintenance in 2nd trimester"
  PROTEIN:
    guideline "1.6..2.0 g/kg/day from mixed sources; distribute 4 meals with 25..40 g high-quality protein each"
  CARBOHYDRATE:
    guideline "3..5 g/kg/day emphasizing complex carbs and fiber for training energy and GI regularity"
  FAT:
    guideline "Balance remainder of calories; include mono- and polyunsaturated fats; limit saturated fats"
  HYDRATION:
    guideline "Aim 2.5..3.0 L fluids/day minimum; add 500 ml around training; include electrolytes if sweating heavily"
  MICRONUTRIENTS:
    guideline "Continue prenatal vitamin per OB; prioritize iron, folate, iodine, vitamin D, calcium, choline, omega-3 DHA"
  PRE_WORKOUT:
    guideline "1..2 hours pre: 30..60 g carbs + 20..30 g protein; avoid high-fat/fiber immediately before training"
  POST_WORKOUT:
    guideline "Within 2 hours: 30..60 g carbs + 25..35 g protein; include fluids and electrolytes"
  MEAL_EXAMPLES:
    item "Breakfast: greek yogurt, oats, berries, chia; or eggs, toast, avocado, fruit"
    item "Lunch: salmon or tofu, quinoa, mixed veg, olive oil; dairy or fortified alt for calcium"
    item "Snack: cottage cheese and fruit; or hummus with whole-grain pita and carrots"
    item "Dinner: lean beef or lentils, brown rice or potatoes, greens; add olive oil or nuts"
  SAFETY_NOTES:
    item "Avoid alcohol; limit high-mercury fish; keep caffeine <=200 mg/day per OB guidance"
    item "Aim for food safety: pasteurized dairy, fully cooked meats/eggs, wash produce"
    item "Monitor GI comfort and reflux: use smaller, frequent meals; elevate carbs around sessions"
  ADJUSTMENTS:
    guideline "If weekly weight gain exceeds OB targets, reduce 100..150 kcal/day; if energy low or losing weight, add 100..200 kcal/day"
  COMPLIANCE_TIPS:
    item "Plan protein at each meal and prep snacks"
    item "Salt to taste unless contraindicated; monitor swelling with OB"
    item "Track with a simple log 3 days/week to ensure protein and fluids targets"
